==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|caryen out}}, equivalent to {{m|en|carry}} + {{m|en|out|pos=adverb}}.<ref>{{R:OED Online|subentry=to carry out|entry=carry|pos=v|id=5843855669}}</ref>

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkæ.ɹi aʊt/}}
** {{a|en|US}} {{IPAchar|/ˈkɛɹ.i aʊt/}}
* {{audio|en|en-au-carry out.ogg|a=AU}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb|*}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To hold while moving it out.
#: {{ux|en|We’ll have to '''carry''' the piano '''out''' of the shop.}}
#* {{RQ:Williams Velveteen Rabbit|passage=And so the little Rabbit was put into a sack with the old picture-books and a lot of rubbish, and '''carried out''' to the end of the garden behind the fowl-house.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|idiomatic}} To [[fulfill]].
#: {{syn|en|discharge}}
#: {{ux|en|She finally '''carried out''' her lifelong ambition when she appeared in a Hollywood blockbuster.}}
#* {{RQ:Williams Velveteen Rabbit|passage=The Boy was going to the seaside to-morrow. Everything was arranged, and now it only remained to '''carry out''' the doctor's orders.}}
#* {{quote-web|en|date=2011-10-07|author=w:Phil McNulty|title=Euro 2012: Montenegro 2-2 England|site=w:BBC Sport|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/15195384.stm|passage=Capello warned his players that caution was not an option as they went in search of the result that would take England to Euro 2012. And his message was '''carried out''' to the letter in the opening exchanges as England played with a tempo and threat Montenegro struggled to subdue.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220203182026/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/15195384}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[execute]] or [[perform]]; to put into [[operation]]; to [[do]].
#: {{syn|en|run}}
#: {{ux|en|For the entire last summer they were '''carrying out''' their plan to renovate the living room.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=1959|month=March|title=The 2,500 h.p. electric locomotives for the Kent Coast electrification|journal=Trains Illustrated|pages=124–125|text=The body design has been '''carried out''' to the requirements of the B.T.C. Design Panel in association with the Design Research Unit and its lines are described as "intentionally unelaborate".}}
